companies.name: アングロ・アメリカン

relations.text: 対等合併でAnglo Teckを設立する計画
relations.text_en: Planned merger of equals to form Anglo Teck

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: expectations related to the "merger of equals" (the "Merger") between Teck and Anglo American plc ("Anglo American") to form Anglo Teck plc ("Anglo Teck");

relations.text: 製鉄用石炭事業の過半をGlencoreに売却(2024年7月完了)
relations.text_en: Bought the majority of its steelmaking coal business (closed July 2024)

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: In November 2023, we announced agreements to sell our entire interest in our steelmaking coal business, through the sale of a majority stake to Glencore and minority stakes to NSC and POSCO.

relations.text: ペルーのアンタミナ銅山の33.75%を保有する共同保有者
relations.text_en: Co-owns 33.75% of the Antamina mine in Peru

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: We indirectly own 22.5% of the Antamina copper/zinc mine in Peru, with the balance held indirectly by BHP Billiton plc (33.75%), Glencore (33.75%) and Mitsubishi Corporation (10%).

relations.text: 製鉄用石炭事業の少数持分を取得(2024年1月完了)
relations.text_en: Bought a minority stake in its steelmaking coal business (closed January 2024)

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: In November 2023, we announced agreements to sell our entire interest in our steelmaking coal business, through the sale of a majority stake to Glencore and minority stakes to NSC and POSCO.

companies.name: ポスコ・ホールディングス

relations.text: 製鉄用石炭事業の少数持分を取得(2024年1月完了)
relations.text_en: Bought a minority stake in its steelmaking coal business (closed January 2024)

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)

relations.text: チリのケブラダ・ブランカ銅山の権益を住友商事と合わせて30%保有
relations.text_en: Holds 30% of Quebrada Blanca in Chile together with Sumitomo Corporation

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. ("SMM") and Sumitomo Corporation ("Sumitomo") collectively hold an indirect 30% interest in QBSA (33.33% of the Series A shares)

relations.text: チリのケブラダ・ブランカ銅山の権益を住友金属鉱山と合わせて30%保有
relations.text_en: Holds 30% of Quebrada Blanca together with Sumitomo Metal Mining

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co., Ltd. ("SMM") and Sumitomo Corporation ("Sumitomo") collectively hold an indirect 30% interest in QBSA (33.33% of the Series A shares)

relations.text: ケブラダ・ブランカの10%の権益(追加出資義務なし)を保有
relations.text_en: Holds a 10% carried interest in Quebrada Blanca

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Corporación Nacional del Cobre de Chile ("Codelco"), a Chilean state-owned mining entity, holds a 10% carried interest in QBSA (100% of the Series B shares)

relations.text: カナダのGalore CreekとチリのNuevaUniónを50:50で共同保有
relations.text_en: 50:50 partner in Galore Creek (Canada) and NuevaUnión (Chile)

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: The project is owned by the Galore Creek Partnership ("GCP"), a 50:50 partnership between Teck and Newmont Corporation ("Newmont")

relations.text: ペルーのアンタミナ銅山の10%を保有する共同保有者
relations.text_en: Holds 10% of the Antamina mine in Peru

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: We indirectly own 22.5% of the Antamina copper/zinc mine in Peru, with the balance held indirectly by BHP Billiton plc (33.75%), Glencore (33.75%) and Mitsubishi Corporation (10%).

relations.text: ペルーのザフラナル計画の20%を保有
relations.text_en: Holds 20% of the Zafranal project in Peru

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: The asset is held by Compañía Minera Zafranal S.A.C., in which Teck holds an 80% interest, with Mitsubishi Materials Corporation holding the remaining 20%.

companies.name: フランコ・ネバダ
companies.sub: ロイヤルティ・ストリーム

relations.text: アンタミナ由来の銀をストリーム契約でFranco-Nevadaに引き渡す
relations.text_en: Delivers Antamina silver to Franco-Nevada under a streaming agreement

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: Under a long-term streaming agreement with FN Holdings ULC ("FNH"), a subsidiary of Franco-Nevada Corporation, Teck has agreed to deliver silver to FNH equivalent to 22.5% of the payable silver sold by CMA.

relations.text: レッドドッグ鉱山の土地を貸し、純収益の一部を受け取る(2025年は3.72億ドル)
relations.text_en: Leases the Red Dog land and receives a share of net proceeds (US$372 million in 2025)

source.label: Teck 年次情報書(10-K添付、2025年度)
source.label_en: Teck annual information form (10-K exhibit, FY2025)
source.quote: The NANA royalty expense in 2025 was US$372 million, compared with US$327 million in 2024.

companies.name: ソリタリオ・リソーシズ

relations.text: アラスカのLik計画の50:50の合弁相手
relations.text_en: 50:50 joint venture partner in the Lik project in Alaska

source.label: Solitario Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Solitario is working with its 50% joint venture partner in the Lik project, Teck American Incorporated, a wholly owned subsidiary of Teck Resources Limited (both companies are referred to as "Teck"), to further the exploration and evaluate potential development plans for the Lik project.

relations.text: BHPが20-Fで、銅の競合の一社としてTeckを挙げる
relations.text_en: BHP names Teck among its copper competitors

source.label: BHP 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Competitors include: Anglo American, Antofagasta, Codelco, Freeport, Glencore, Rio Tinto, Southern Copper, Teck.
